description: Update an existing time entry — change its description, start, duration, billable flag, tags or linked task. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated entry.

billable.description: Set true/false to change the billable flag.

description.description: New note. Omit to keep current.

start.description: New start time (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

tags.description: Replacement array of time-entry tag objects.

task_id.description: New task id to associate the entry with.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

timer_id.description: ID of the time entry to update.

name: update_time_entry
